name: Variman Global Enterprises Ltd.
summary: Variman Global Enterprises Ltd. specializes in the distribution of information technology and mobile solutions. The company serves as a vital strategic intermediary, connecting technology vendors with their partners to facilitate optimal business performance. Its comprehensive client base includes small office/home office (SOHO) setups, small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs), mid-sized companies, large corporations, and government entities across numerous industry verticals. Established on December 20, 2013, the firm's main office is situated in Hyderabad, India.
